tickets.description: Our payment processing webhooks failed 12 times in the last 40 minutes due to 504 timeouts on the cluster proxy.

messages.text: Emergency: our production webhook endpoint is receiving 504 Gateway Timeout intermittently!

Internal Note: Worker pool capacity hit 100% due to an unindexed query on payload table. Deploying index fix.
